## File: facebookresearch_grounded-video-description/tools/vg_cls_overlap.py

Prompts

```
['run the script to analyze class vocabulary overlap between Visual Genome and Something-Something v2 datasets', 'run get_dataset_cls to extract object class vocabulary from VG, Flickr30k, Open Image, SS2, or ANet datasets', 'run load_corpus to load and return sentences from Flickr30k, SS2, or ANet grounding datasets', 'review get_dataset_cls which uses Stanford CoreNLP to lemmatize class names and filter by frequency threshold', 'review main which compares two dataset class dictionaries and reports missing vocabulary with corpus frequency']
```
